title: Bright Smiles Dental and Clinic Scheduler: first meeting

slides.title: Fewer no-shows at Bright Smiles Dental
slides.subtitle: Clinic Scheduler: a first conversation with Priya Nair, COO
slides.notes: Thank Priya for her time. Say the meeting is about no-shows.

slides.title: About 9% of your appointments are no-shows

numbers.label: Of appointments are no-shows, as you told us

points.text: You told us this figure yourselves
How many appointments does one clinic book in a month?

slides.notes: Bright Smiles runs 40 clinics in England and Wales. You told us no-shows run at about 9% of appointments. Ask how many appointments a clinic books, so the cost can be sized together.

slides.title: Clinic Scheduler books, reminds and refills slots
slides.notes: Clinic Scheduler has three parts: online booking, text reminders, and a waitlist that fills cancelled slots. Ask how her clinics book, remind and refill slots today.

slides.title: No-shows fell from 8% to 5% in our pilot

numbers.label: No-shows before, in our 3 pilot clinics

points.text: Our pilot report's estimate: a 3-point fall in 3 months
Your clinics start higher, at about 9%

slides.notes: In our 3 pilot clinics, no-shows fell from 8% to 5% in 3 months. Our internal pilot report gives this as an estimate.

slides.title: The same fall would bring you to about 6%

numbers.label: With the same 3-point fall, our estimate

points.text: Our estimate, not a promise: a pilot in your clinics would measure it
What does an empty slot cost one of your clinics?

slides.notes: If Bright Smiles saw the same 3-point fall as our pilot clinics, no-shows would go from about 9% to about 6%. This is our estimate from only 3 pilot clinics; a pilot in her clinics would measure whether it holds.

slides.title: A pilot in a few of your clinics would measure it

steps.heading: Choose
steps.text: We agree with you which clinics, how many, and for how long

steps.heading: Run
steps.text: Those clinics use online booking, text reminders and the waitlist

steps.heading: Measure
steps.text: We compare the no-show rate before and after

slides.notes: We propose a pilot in a few of her clinics. Which clinics, how many and how long are agreed with her. The pilot is judged on the no-show rate before and after.

slides.title: Next step: agree a pilot at £120 per clinic a month

steps.heading: We propose
steps.text: A pilot in a few of your clinics at £120 per clinic per month, list price

steps.heading: From you
steps.text: Which clinics, how many, how long, and the start date

steps.heading: How we judge it
steps.text: The no-show rate before and after; yours is about 9% today

slides.notes: The ask: a pilot in a few clinics at the list price of £120 per clinic per month. Which clinics, how many, how long and the start date are agreed with her, and the pilot is judged on the no-show rate before and after. First, ask how many appointments her clinics book, to size the cost of no-shows together. If she asks about all 40 clinics: £4,800 a month at list price, our estimate. Ask which clinics she would want first.
